subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about driving qualified property leads for {Brand} in the UK market. The one point worth repeating: we optimise to the verified buyer or vendor enquiry and read it back through your CRM rather than the install, so the volume you pay for is validated leads, with bots, recycled form-fills and duplicate enquiries screened out before billing. At scale we hold 900 qualified property leads a day (illustrative) at that quality. If it helps, I can pull the region-level qualified-lead view for your stock?
angle: warm bump, restate qualified-lead CRM-read proof
illustrative_flags: 900 qualified property leads a day (MobUpps-specific daily qualified-lead volume; illustrative)
register_notes: Stage 1 EN real_estate_proptech UK native register: references prior outreach in S1; restates single proof (optimise to verified enquiry + CRM-side read + pre-billing fraud screen); one illustrative MobUpps figure (900 qualified property leads a day, flagged); soft CTA, exactly 1 question mark; no sign-off; brands only from candidates ({Brand} token); no X-not-Y; no em-dash; market context none needed in S1.
